summary: NeuroOne Medical Technologies Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to increase the amount of common stock available for sale under an existing at-the-market (ATM) offering agreement with JonesTrading Institutional Services LLC, from prior amounts to $13,400,000. As of the filing date, approximately $8,359,586 had already been sold under the agreement. The filing updates the registration and does not involve a standalone event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. It is a routine capital markets transaction to raise equity, not a special situation.
